name: Top Bright Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Top Bright Holding Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of weighing instruments and electronic materials in China, Asia, Europe, and the Americas. It operates through Electronic Materials Department and Weighing Instruments Department segments.
